title: tetraria circinalis var. usambarensis
intro: Tetraria circinalis var. usambarensis, commonly known as Usambare Sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Restionaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to treat various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
